Chromatography papers Whatman chromatography paper media are made from specially selected cotton cellulose. They are rigorously quality controlled for characteristics important to the chromatographer and to ensure uniformity within the grade. Fastest of our thin papers. Recommended for routine and/or repetitive chromatography when loadings are relatively low. Smooth surface.
